prompt.content:
You are writing internal knowledge-base articles for an enterprise support team, for a synthetic dataset used to build and evaluate KB-recommendation systems. For each article brief in the input JSON array, write a TITLE, a one-to-two sentence CONTENT_SUMMARY (what an agent sees in search results), and a CONTENT_BODY of 3-6 short sentences (a practical troubleshooting note: what to check, what usually causes it, how it's typically resolved) consistent with the given category/symptoms/root causes/resolutions. Vary style: some articles are broad and reference-like, some are narrowly specific with numbered steps. If "outdated" is true, the body should read like guidance that predates a later product change (e.g. reference an older flow) without literally saying "this article is outdated".

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"articles": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "content_summary": "...", "content_body": "..."}, ...]} covering every article index, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'category': 'Authorization / Permissions', 'subcategory_names': ['RBAC failure', 'conditional access block', 'policy misapplication'], 'symptom_names': ['user sees wrong data', 'elevated privileges observed', 'HTTP 401', 'wrong tenant data shown', 'access granted incorrectly', 'permission denied unexpectedly'], 'root_cause_names': ['customer configuration error', 'improper access review', 'operator error'], 'resolution_names': ['configuration change', 'permission update', 'customer education', 'documentation correction', 'access review completed'], 'product_names': ['MFA Manager', 'Invoice Service'], 'specificity': 'broad', 'outdated': True}]

response: {"articles": [{"i": 0, "title": "Troubleshooting RBAC and Conditional Access Issues in MFA Manager and Invoice Service", "content_summary": "Guidance for resolving unexpected permission denials, privilege escalation, or data visibility errors related to Role-Based Access Control and conditional access policies. Note that this article references the legacy 'Access Rules' tab structure which has been deprecated in favor of the new 'Policy Engine' interface.", "content_body": "When users report seeing wrong tenant data or receiving HTTP 401 errors, first verify the current role assignments within the legacy 'Access Rules' tab of MFA Manager. Ensure that conditional access blocks are not inadvertently overriding specific invoice service permissions due to outdated group mappings. Most incidents are resolved by correcting customer configuration errors or completing a pending access review that was skipped during recent updates. Educate stakeholders on the difference between immediate access grants and scheduled privilege reviews to prevent future misapplication."}]}
